prompt: Photorealistic cinematic live action, exactly as in the image: the woman in the green T-shirt keeps both hands on her phone exactly as they are and reads it, her eyes moving down the screen; she glances once at the labelled carton on the shelf beside her and back to the phone, and gives a small satisfied nod; behind her the volunteers carry sealed cartons in from the van, one setting his on the shelf, walking naturally. The camera holds with a very slow drift to the right. No other text, letters, logos or lettering appear anywhere. Natural light, 35 mm, shallow depth of field, no handheld shake.
